description: Geometric meridian-boost u(q₀)=ln q₀ (meridian-holonomy-boost.md) tested against the S-channel under the CORRECTED harmonic Im 𝔙₄₁=(√3/4)(Re²u−Im²u) (#4372). Real boost is muon-sign-correct + right ballpark (Im 𝔙₄₁>0, ~0.5×S_mu) but REFUTED as the full map (scope-(a)): nearly constant across the ~1e-6-apart anchor q₀'s, cannot produce S(proton)<0 or the S gap. Sign-flip requires the boost→spin transition (complex/spin part crossing the diagonal); that part is the OPEN u(q₀). Corrects the third wrong-form probe (qbeta_c3_geometry_derived_argument_probe.py). No fit, no c_k, no instance.
